caption:
A hundred listings copied from a supplier catalog compete with lakhs of identical ones. Ten products you know inside out let you write sharper titles, answer buyer questions in minutes and spot a price shift before it hurts you. Depth wins searches. Breadth wins nothing on its own.

Comment with two numbers: listings in your shop, and how many you could describe from memory.
